blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Mechanical blueberry harvesting requires a balance between removing ripe fruit and avoiding premature removal of unripe berries that could remain on the bush for a later harvest. However, operators generally lack real-time information about the maturity composition of the fruit being collected. This study develops an event-triggered machine-vision system that measures the maturity of harvested blueberries directly on the harvester. When a filled crate is moved by the machine, an RGB image is automatically captured and analysed using a three-class detector that identifies ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe berries. The system operates locally on the existing CPU-only industrial computer and therefore requires neither continuous image processing nor dedicated GPU hardware. During field testing, 79 crate images containing 48,634 visible blueberries in manually verified reference annotations were evaluated. The vision system estimated an overall ripe-fruit fraction of 90.22%, compared with 90.97% determined manually. Per-image ripe-fruit estimates showed a mean absolute error of 0.935 percentage points and a Pearson correlation of r=0.967. Maturity estimates remained similar between the two sides of the harvester for which the light conditions varied despite poorer absolute counting performance under direct sunlight. All field events were processed within the available 14 s per-side crate interval. The proposed approach provides a practical means of quantifying one component of harvest selectivity while the machine is operating. Such information could support operator decision-making and, when combined with measurements of fruit recovery and losses, contribute to future feedback-based control of mechanical harvesting.
blocks.zh: 机械取出蓝莓需要平衡兼顾取出成熟水果和避免过早取出可留入灌木丛后再取出未成熟的浆果。 然而,操作者一般缺乏关于所收集的水果成熟度成分的实时信息. 本研究开发出一种事件触发机视系统,直接在收割机上测量所收获蓝莓的成熟度. 当一个装满了的箱子被机器移动时,一个RGB图像会自动被捕获,并使用三等探测器进行分析,这种探测器可以识别出成熟的,半圆形的,和不圆形的浆果. 该系统在现有的只使用CPU的工业计算机上局部运行,因此既不需要连续的图像处理,也不需要专门的GPU硬件. 在现场测试中,对79个箱型图像进行了评估,这些图像在人工核实的参考说明中包含48 634个可见蓝莓。 视力系统估计总的成熟水果分数为90.22%,而人工确定的成熟水果分数为90.97%。 每幅图像成熟果实的估计数显示,平均绝对误差为0.935个百分点,而皮尔逊的相关误差为0.967. 收割机两侧的成熟度估计仍然相近,尽管在直接阳光下绝对计数性能较差,但光线条件却各不相同。 所有外地活动都是在14个每箱间隔内处理的。 拟议办法为在机器运行期间量化收获选择的一个部分提供了实用手段。 此类信息可以支持经营者的决策,如果与对水果回收和损失的测量相结合,有助于今后对机械收割的反馈控制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Mechanical harvesting has become increasingly significant in blueberry production due to its ability to reduce reliance on seasonal human labour and facilitate rapid harvesting across large fields. The primary objective for growers extends beyond maximising the immediate weight of berries collected. It is to optimise the overall value of the field, which typically requires three harvests per season. For fresh-market production, machines must efficiently harvest fruit while preserving quality and minimising the collection of unripe berries that require further ripening. Previous studies show that machine design, harvesting intervals, and fruit handling affect fresh-market quality [ 3 , 7 , 26 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于能够减少对季节性人类劳动力的依赖,促进跨越大片田地的快速采伐,机械采伐在蓝莓生产中变得越来越重要. 种植者的首要目标不仅仅是最大限度地扩大所采集浆果的直接重量。 它是为了优化田地的整体价值,这通常需要每个季节三次收获. 在新市场生产方面,机器必须有效地收获水果,同时保持质量,尽量减少需要进一步成熟的未熟浆果的收集。 以往的研究表明,机器设计、收获间隔和水果处理影响到新鲜市场的质量[3、7、26、27]。

blocks.en: The objective of this study is to develop and field-test an event-triggered computer-vision system that estimates the maturity composition of blueberries directly on a mechanical harvester while harvesting is in progress. A key challenge in current harvesting operations is the lack of immediate feedback on the maturity composition of collected fruit. Commercial sorter and packout results provide valuable information about harvested product quality, but these measurements are generally available only after harvesting. Similar real-time monitoring approaches have been investigated for other harvested crops [ 12 , 13 , 4 , 30 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项研究的目的是开发和实地测试一个事件触发的计算机-视觉系统,该系统在收获过程中直接在机械收割机上估计蓝莓的成熟度组成。 目前收获作业的一个关键挑战是,对所采集的水果的成熟度组成缺乏即时反馈。 商业分拣和包装结果提供了关于收获产品质量的宝贵信息,但这些测量结果一般只能在收获后提供。 对其他收获作物进行了类似的实时监测方法调查[12、13、4、30、25]。

blocks.en: Computer vision has also been widely investigated in blueberry production, including maturity classification, yield estimation, and machine-mounted monitoring [ 16 , 31 , 8 , 22 , 20 , 32 , 6 , 11 , 23 ] . However, the real-time assessment of blueberry maturity after mechanical detachment remains comparatively unexplored.
blocks.zh: 计算机视觉在蓝莓生产中也得到了广泛的调查,包括成熟度分类,产量估计,以及机载监测[16,31,8,22,20,32,6,11,23]. 然而,对机械分解后蓝莓成熟度的实时评估仍然相对没有进行探讨.

blocks.en: The main contribution of this work is the integration of event-triggered crate imaging, three-class blueberry maturity detection, and local CPU inference into a field-deployed monitoring system. The approach is evaluated using 79 field-acquired crate images with manually annotated blueberries, examining maturity-estimation accuracy and processing performance under operating conditions. Rather than introducing a new detection architecture or implementing automatic machine control, the study investigates whether harvested-fruit maturity can be measured sufficiently accurately and promptly to support future feedback-based harvesting. Because maturity composition alone does not measure fruit remaining on the bush or losses to the ground, it is considered one component of harvest selectivity rather than a complete measure of harvesting efficiency.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是将事件触发的板条箱成像,三级蓝莓成熟度检测,以及局部CPU推论整合到外地部署的监测系统中. 采用79个实地采购的箱型图像对这种方法进行评价,并用人工说明蓝莓,审查成熟度-估计准确性和操作条件下的处理性能。 该研究没有引入新的探测架构,也没有实施自动机器控制,而是调查是否能够充分准确和迅速地衡量收获果的成熟度,以支持今后基于反馈的收获。 由于成熟成分本身不能衡量树丛中残留的水果或地面损失,因此,它被认为是收获选择的一个组成部分,而不是衡量收获效率的完整尺度。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Previous research on computer vision in blueberry production has primarily focused on maturity assessment and yield estimation before harvesting. Early studies used RGB imaging to identify different blueberry growth stages [ 16 ] , while hyperspectral imaging was investigated for distinguishing fruit maturity under field conditions [ 31 ] . More recent research has employed deep-learning approaches, particularly YOLO-based detectors, for maturity classification, berry counting, and yield estimation [ 8 , 22 ] . Similar approaches have also been applied to ripeness detection for robotic picking [ 20 ] and three-dimensional fruit localisation [ 32 ] . Although these studies demonstrate the feasibility of visual maturity assessment under outdoor conditions, they primarily examine berries still attached to the plant rather than fruit collected by mechanical harvesters.
blocks.zh: 以前对蓝莓生产中的计算机视觉的研究主要侧重于收获前的成熟度评估和产量估计。 早期研究利用RGB成像来识别不同的蓝莓生长阶段[16],同时对超光谱成像进行了调查,以区分场条件下的水果成熟度[31]. 最近的研究采用了深入学习的方法,特别是基于YOLO的探测器,用于成熟度分类、莓汁计数和产量估计[8,22]。 类似的方法也应用于对机器人采摘[20]和三维水果本地化的成熟度检测[32]. 虽然这些研究证明了在户外条件下进行视觉成熟度评估的可行性,但它们主要检查仍附着在植物上的浆果,而不是机械收割机采集的水果.

blocks.en: Real-time monitoring of harvested-product quality has also been investigated in other agricultural applications. [ 12 , 13 ] developed machine-vision systems to inspect harvested paddy for damaged grain and unwanted material, including the presentation of quality information to operators during harvesting. Similar systems have been developed to monitor grain breakage and impurity content in combine harvesters [ 4 , 30 ] . In potato harvesting, computer vision has been applied to detect potatoes and soil clods, estimate tuber dimensions, and identify damaged products [ 1 , 2 , 25 ] . Together, these studies demonstrate that harvested-product characteristics can be monitored during machine operation and potentially used to support adjustments to harvesting settings.
blocks.zh: 对其他农业应用的收获产品质量进行了实时监测。 [12,13]开发了机器-视觉系统,以检查收获的稻田中受损的谷物和不需要的材料,包括在收获期间向操作人员提供质量信息. 开发了类似的系统,以监测联合收割机中的谷物破损和杂质含量[4,30]. 在马铃薯收获中,已应用计算机视觉探测马铃薯和土壤块块,估计茎尺寸,并查明受损产品[1、2、25]。 这些研究表明,在机器运行期间可以监测收获产品的特点,并可能用来支持调整收获环境。

blocks.en: Machine-mounted vision systems have also been developed specifically for blueberry harvesting. [ 6 ] used RGB cameras to detect berries and unwanted material, including leaves, stems, and dirt, on a commercial wild-blueberry harvester. [ 11 ] employed an OAK-D camera and deep-learning methods to estimate fruit height and automatically adjust harvester-header positioning. More closely related to the present study, [ 23 ] developed a real-time yield-monitoring system using a three-dimensional time-of-flight camera to estimate the mass of harvested blueberries in totes while accounting for debris. However, their objectives focus on debris detection, machine positioning, and harvested mass rather than the maturity composition of the collected fruit.
blocks.zh: 还专门为蓝莓收获开发了机器式视觉系统。 [6] 使用RGB摄像头在商业野生蓝莓收割机上探测浆果和不良物质,包括树叶,茎和泥土. [11] 采用了OAK-D相机和深层学习方法来估计水果高度并自动调整收割机-头部定位. 与本研究更密切相关的是,[23]利用三维飞行时间摄像机开发了一个实时产量监测系统,在计算碎片时估计收获的蓝莓的质量。 然而,它们的目标侧重于碎片探测、机器定位和收获的质量,而不是所收集水果的成熟度组成。

blocks.en: Beyond maturity assessment, previous research has also examined the effects of mechanical harvesting on blueberry quality. Studies of modified over-the-row harvesters have shown that catching surfaces, harvesting configurations, and fruit handling influence firmness, bruising, and fresh-market suitability [ 7 , 26 , 27 ] . Postharvest sensing methods, including hyperspectral imaging, have also been investigated for predicting fruit firmness and identifying internal bruising [ 15 , 9 ] . These properties are important for determining commercial quality but differ from colour-based maturity composition.
blocks.zh: 除了成熟度评估外,先前的研究还审查了机械采伐对蓝莓质量的影响。 对经过改造的超排收割机的研究表明,捕捉表面、收割布局和水果处理影响到固态、瘀伤和新鲜市场的适宜性[7、26、27]。 还研究了收获后遥感方法,包括超光谱成像,以预测水果坚固度和确定内部瘀伤[15,9]。 这些特性对确定商业质量很重要,但不同于基于颜色的成熟成分。

blocks.en: 3 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 3 材料和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Study context and harvester configuration
blocks.zh: 3.1 研究背景和收割机配置

blocks.en: The system was tested on a FineField Harvy 500 mechanical blueberry harvester (Fig. 1 ) in Weeze, Germany, on 21 July 2026. The harvester operates bidirectionally, meaning that its direction of travel can be reversed. Therefore, the two sides are not designated as left and right, but instead as the blue side and the white side. Each side operates independently, with its own crate-filling system, crates, crate pusher, and fixed camera positioned above the filled crate. The cameras do not observe the same crate from different angles; instead, each camera records a separate crate from its respective side of the machine.
blocks.zh: 该系统于2026年7月21日在德国威泽的一架FineField Harvy 500机械蓝莓收割机(图1)上进行了测试. 收割机双向运行,意味着其旅行方向可以逆转. 因此,双方不指定为左派和右派,而是指定为蓝派和白派. 每一方均独立运作,有自己的箱装系统、箱装箱、箱装推重机和固定相机在装满的箱装箱上方。 摄像头不从不同角度观察同一个箱子;相反,每个摄像头从机器的各自侧面记录一个单独的箱子.

blocks.en: Figure 1: FineField Harvy 500 mechanical blueberry harvester operating in a blueberry field. Photograph taken on a different day from the reported field experiment.
blocks.zh: 图1:在蓝莓田里作业的精良野外哈维500机械蓝莓收割机. 拍摄时间与报道的现场实验不同.

blocks.en: During harvesting, blueberries are removed from the bush using shaker heads and transported to the crate using a catching surface that directs the berries into small buckets, which then drop them into the crate. When a crate reaches a set weight threshold (in this case 6.5 kg), it is pushed and replaced by an empty crate.
blocks.zh: 在收获期间,蓝莓用摇头从灌木丛中取出,然后用一个将浆果引向小桶的捕捉表面运到箱内,然后将浆果扔到箱内。 当一个箱子达到规定的重量阈值(在此情况下为6.5公斤)时,便被推开,换成空箱.

blocks.en: 3.2 Camera position and field of view
blocks.zh: 3.2 相机位置和视场

blocks.en: The same camera settings and angle were used on both the blue and white sides. The cameras were positioned approximately 20 cm above the crate, meaning we used wide-field-of-view lenses. The crop, camera installation, and collected fruit are illustrated in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 蓝色和白色两侧都使用了相同的相机设置和角度. 摄像头的位置在箱子上方约20厘米处,这意味着我们使用了宽视野的镜头. 图2显示了作物、照相机安装和收集的水果。

blocks.en: The camera system used a 5 MP, 1/1.8-inch CMOS global-shutter sensor. A global shutter was selected because it captures the entire image simultaneously, helping reduce image distortion caused by movement or vibration. The camera module can provide images at up to 2448 × \times 2048 pixels at 30 frames per second and supports manual or automatic white balance, shutter speeds from 1/12 s to 1/100,000 s, backlight compensation, strong-light suppression, noise reduction, and digital wide dynamic range. Its specified operating temperature is − - 20 °C to +60 °C.
blocks.zh: 相机系统使用5 MP,1/1.8英寸CMOS环球-shutter传感器. 选择一个全局百叶窗是因为它同时捕捉整个图像,帮助减少运动或振动造成的图像扭曲. 相机模块可提供高达2448×\time2048像素的图像,每秒30帧,并支持手动或自动白色平衡,闭路器速度从1/12s到1/100000s,背光补偿,强光压制,降噪,数字宽动态范围. 其规定的操作温度为−-20°C至+60°C.

blocks.en: For installation on the harvester, the cameras were placed in weather-resistant housings rated IP67 or higher and connected through active Power over Ethernet (PoE). This allowed both power and network communication to be provided via the camera connection, reducing the amount of wiring required on the machine.
blocks.zh: 为安装在收割机上,相机被放置在被评为IP67或更高且通过以太网(PoE)上的主动电源连接的耐天气舱内. 这使得电力和网络通信都能够通过相机连接提供,减少了机上所需的电线量.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Field context of the study: (a) blueberry crop entering the mechanical picking zone; (b) machine-mounted camera positioned above the crate stream; and (c) harvested product showing ripe, semi-ripe, unripe fruit and debris.
blocks.zh: 图2:研究的实地背景:(a) 进入机械采摘区的蓝莓作物;(b) 位于板条溪之上的机载相机;(c) 收获的产品,显示成熟、半熟、未熟的水果和碎片。

blocks.en: Only the top layer of the berries is visible in each image. There was no space for the camera above the crate that is currently being filled, as the leaf blower would blow dirt and leaves into the camera. Instead, each image is treated as a sample of the harvested product.
blocks.zh: 每个图像中只可见浆果的顶层. 目前装满的箱子上方没有摄像头的空间,因为吹叶机会把泥土吹入摄像头。 相反,每个图像都被当作收获产品的样本。

blocks.en: 3.3 Event-triggered image capture
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 事件触发图像抓取

blocks.en: Image capture was synchronised with the crate-handling system rather than performed continuously. When a filled crate was pushed from the collection position, a sensor triggered a signal sent to the industrial PC. The trigger also identified which side of the harvester had pushed the crate. After receiving the signal, the software waited one second before capturing an image from the corresponding camera. This delay allowed the crate to move into a stable position before the image was taken.
blocks.zh: 图像捕获与板条箱处理系统同步,而不是连续进行。 当一个装满的箱子被从收集位置推出时,一个传感器触发了发送到工业PC的信号. 触发器还确定了收割机的哪一边推了箱子。 软件收到信号后,等待了1秒钟,才从相应的相机中捕捉到一个图像. 这种延迟使得箱子在拍摄图像之前能够移动到稳定的位置.

blocks.en: This event-triggered approach reduced unnecessary image processing and created a direct link between the machine event and the recorded sample. Each trigger produced one timestamped crate image and one corresponding maturity-analysis result. The system also recorded capture events in log files, enabling the identification of missed or incorrectly timed images.
blocks.zh: 这种事件触发方法减少了不必要的图像处理,并在机器事件和记录样本之间建立了直接联系. 每个触发器都产生一个印有两次标记的箱子图像和一个相应的成熟度分析结果. 该系统还记录了日志文件中的捕获事件,从而能够识别丢失或错时的图像.

blocks.en: 3.4 Datasets and Annotations
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据集和说明

blocks.en: The model was developed using two publicly available blueberry datasets and a small number of additional photographs. The first was the Blueberry Detection Dataset [ 17 ] , which contains images of blueberries with bounding-box annotations. The OPENset subset was used to train the initial single-class detector. It contained 79 public images, and one additional crate image was included in the training dataset. In total, this dataset contained 80 images and 4,248 annotated blueberries, with 59 images for training, 16 for validation, and 5 for testing. The source images had different resolutions, and the model used an input size of 640 × 640 640\times 640 pixels during training.
blocks.zh: 该模型的开发使用了两套公开的蓝莓数据集和少量的额外照片. 第一个是蓝莓探测数据集[17],其中包含蓝莓的图像,并附有边框说明. OPENset子集被用来训练最初的单级探测器. 它载有79个公共图像,另有一个箱子图像被列入培训数据集。 这个数据集总共包含80幅图像和4,248幅注解蓝莓,其中59幅图像用于训练,16幅用于验证,5幅用于测试. 源图像有不同的分辨率,模型在训练时使用了640×640640\time640像素的输入大小.

blocks.en: For the maturity classification task, images of individual blueberries from the Blueberry Maturity Classification dataset [ 18 ] were used to train a preliminary YOLO26s model to distinguish between ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe blueberries. This model was then applied to a collection of images selected from Li’s Blueberry Detection Dataset [ 18 ] and additional images provided by FineField from previous harvests, showing blueberries growing close together or overlapping on bushes. For the images from [ 18 ] , the existing bounding-box annotations were retained, and the preliminary model was used to assign maturity classes to the detected berries. The predicted classes were then manually reviewed and corrected where necessary using the Computer Vision Annotation Tool (CVAT) [ 5 ] . For the FineField images, bounding boxes were manually annotated, and maturity classes were assigned.
blocks.zh: 对于成熟度分类任务,蓝莓成熟度分类数据集[18]中的单个蓝莓的图像被用于训练一种初步的YOLO26s模型,以区分成熟,半生莓,和未成熟蓝莓. 这个模型后来被应用到李氏蓝莓检测数据集[18]中选取的图像集以及FineField提供的以往收获的其他图像中,显示蓝莓在灌木丛上紧密生长或重叠. 对于来自[18]的图像,保留了现有的边框说明,并使用初步模型为检测到的浆果指定成熟等级. 然后,利用计算机视野注释工具(CVAT)对预测的类别进行人工审查,并在必要时加以更正[5]。 对于 FineField 图像,边框是手动附加说明的,并指定了到期类。

blocks.en: The maturity classes were defined mainly by the visible colour of the berries. Ripe berries were predominantly blue, unripe berries were mainly green, and semi-ripe berries were between these two stages. The final recorded three-class training dataset contained 106 image files derived from 55 distinct original photographs. It contained 8,455 bounding-box annotations, including 7,587 ripe, 571 unripe, and 297 semi-ripe berries. These totals include augmented copies of the original photographs. The images were 640 × 640 640\times 640 -pixel exports.
blocks.zh: 成熟等级主要由浆果的明显颜色来定义. 里皮浆果以蓝色为主,未里皮浆果以绿色为主,半里皮浆果介于这两个阶段之间. 最终录制的三等训练数据集包含106个图像文件,取自55张不同的原始照片。 它包含8,455个边框说明,包括7,587个熟的,571个未熟的,297个半熟的浆果. 这些总数包括增加的原始照片副本。 图像为640×640 640\times 640 - 像素输出.

blocks.en: 3.5 Model Training
blocks.zh: 3.5 示范培训

blocks.en: The final detector was developed in two main phases using YOLO26s [ 14 ] . The starting model was pretrained on the COCO dataset [ 19 ] . First, the model was trained to detect blueberries as a single class, without distinguishing their maturity. This detector was then used as the starting point for the three-class maturity model. The final system therefore used one detector to both locate each berry and assign it to the ripe, semi-ripe, or unripe class.
blocks.zh: 最终的探测器是采用YOLO26s[14]分两个主要阶段开发的. 开始模型在COCO数据集上预训[19]. 首先,该模型被训练为检测蓝莓作为单级,而没有区分其成熟度. 这个探测器后来被用作三等成熟模型的起点. 因此,最终系统使用一个探测器来确定每个莓子的位置,并将其分配到熟、半熟或无熟的类别。

blocks.en: The initial blueberry detector was trained for up to 100 epochs, with a batch size of 16 and an input resolution of 640 × 640 640\times 640 pixels. Early stopping was enabled with a patience of 20 epochs. Training ended at epoch 99, and the best checkpoint was obtained at epoch 79. The single-class detector was subsequently refined in three runs of 50, 30, and 20 epochs. The first used an input resolution of 640 × 640 640\times 640 pixels and the remaining two used 960 × 960 960\times 960 pixels. Each run was started from the previous detector checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 最初的蓝莓探测器被训练了多达100个纪元,批量大小为16个,输入分辨率为640×640 640\times 640像素. 以20个纪元的耐性实现了早期停止. 培训在99世纪结束,在79世纪获得最佳检查站。 单级探测器随后在50,30,20个纪元的三次运行中得到了完善. 第一个使用了640×640 640\time640像素的输入分辨率,其余两个使用了960×960\time960像素. 每次运行都是从前一个探测器检查站开始的.

blocks.en: The final detector was initialised from the refined single-class model. The final training run used Ultralytics 8.4.16, 100 epochs, a batch size of 6, and an input resolution of 960 × 960 960\times 960 pixels. Its best checkpoint was obtained at epoch 86.
blocks.zh: 最后的探测器从精制的单级模型中宣告出来. 最终的训练运行使用了超解8.4.16,100个纪元,批量大小为6,输入分辨率为960×960960\times960像素. 其最佳检查站是在86世纪获得的。

blocks.en: The optimiser was selected automatically by Ultralytics [ 29 ] . It chose AdamW [ 21 ] with an effective initial learning rate of approximately 0.002 for the initial single-class run and 0.001429 for the final three-class run. The selected rate was used rather than testing several learning rates manually. The final run used an AdamW first-moment coefficient of 0.9 and effective weight decay of approximately 5.16 × 10 − 4 5.16\times 10^{-4} . A random seed of 42, deterministic training, and mixed precision were enabled. The training configuration requested two warm-up epochs. Ultralytics’ optimiser behaviour is described in its training documentation [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: optimiser被Ultralytics自动选中[29]. 它选择了AdamW [21],在最初的单级赛跑中有效的初始学习率约为0.002,在最后的三级赛跑中则选择了0.001429. 使用了选定的比率,而不是手工测试几种学习比率。 最终运行使用了 AdamW 0.9 的第一动系数,有效重量衰减约为 5.16 × 10 − 4.5.16\times 10^{-4}. 启用了42个随机种子、确定型训练和混合精度。 训练配置要求两个热身时代. 超解析器的偏好行为在其培训文件中作了描述[29]。

blocks.en: Data augmentation was used to expose the detector to variation in berry appearance, position, and image brightness. The initial training stage used the default Ultralytics settings. For the later fine-tuning runs, mosaic augmentation, scaling, translation, and colour changes were reduced. This was intended to provide variation without changing the fruit colour too strongly, since colour was also the main cue used to distinguish maturity classes. The settings used in the first and final stages are compared in Table 1 [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 利用数据增强使探测器暴露在莓的外观、位置和图像亮度方面的变化。 初始培训阶段使用了默认的超解析设置. 对于后来的微调运行,马赛克增殖,缩放,翻译和颜色变化都减少了. 这样做是为了在不过分改变水果颜色的情况下提供变异性,因为颜色也是用来区分成熟等级的主要标志。 表1[28]比较了第一阶段和最后阶段使用的设置。

blocks.en: Table 1: Data augmentation settings used during initial blueberry detection and final maturity fine-tuning. The initial stage used Ultralytics defaults; values for the final stage were set in the training script.
blocks.zh: 表1:初步蓝莓检测和最终成熟度微调时使用的数据增强设置. 初始阶段使用Ultlytics默认;最终阶段的值设定在训练脚本中.

blocks.zh: 3.6 推论管道和成熟度-组合估计

blocks.en: 3.7 Data logging and traceability
blocks.zh: 3.7 (中文(简体) ). 数据记录和可追踪性

blocks.en: For each captured crate, the system stores the image together with the corresponding analysis results. The saved information includes the camera side, capture identifier, timestamp, image size, ripe count, semi-ripe count, unripe count, total number of detected berries, and the calculated maturity-composition estimate. The system also stores individual detections, including their class, confidence score, and bounding-box coordinates. Runtime performance was evaluated from the logs recorded during the 79-event field experiment.
blocks.zh: 对于每个被捕获的箱子,系统将图像连同相应的分析结果一起存储. 保存的信息包括相机侧面,捕捉标识符,时间戳,图像大小,成熟计数,半磁盘计数,未磁盘计数,检测到的浆果总数,以及计算成熟度-组合估计. 该系统还存储了个人检测,包括其类,置信分,以及边框坐标. 从79项活动现场试验期间记录的日志中评估了运行时间的性能。

blocks.en: 3.8 Deployment and OpenVINO inference
blocks.zh: 3.8 部署和OpenVINO推论

blocks.en: The final detection system was run on the industrial computer installed on the harvester rather than on the more powerful computer used during model development. The industrial PC contains an Intel Celeron J1900 processor running at approximately 1.99 GHz, with four CPU cores and approximately 3.7 GB of RAM. No GPU was used during the reported deployment.
blocks.zh: 最后的检测系统运行在安装在收割机上的工业计算机上,而不是在模型开发期间使用的更强大的计算机上. 工业PC包含一个Intel Celeron J1900处理器,运行速度约为1.99GHz,有4个CPU核心和大约3.7GB的RAM. 在报告的部署期间没有使用GPU。

blocks.en: The trained YOLO26s model was exported to OpenVINO and run using CPU inference. The deployed model used an input image size of 1280 × \times 1280 pixels. Because images are captured only when crates are pushed, continuous video processing is not required. The system’s processing speed was benchmarked on the industrial PC using the deployed 1280 × \times 1280 OpenVINO model, and a separate benchmark compared the 1280 and 960 input sizes.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的YOLO26s型号被出口到OpenVINO,并使用CPU推论运行. 部署的模型使用输入图像大小为1280×\times 1280像素. 因为图像只有在板条箱被推时才被捕获,所以不需要连续的视频处理. 该系统的处理速度是采用部署的1280×\times 1280 OpenVINO模型在工业PC上设定的基准,与1280和960的输入尺寸相比有一个单独的基准.

blocks.en: 3.9 Field data collection and packout data
blocks.zh: 3.9 (中文(简体) ). 实地数据收集和包装数据

blocks.en: The field evaluation used 79 filled-crate images: 40 from the blue side and 39 from the white side. The cameras captured images at 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 pixels. These images were not used during model training. The sun-affected images were retained in the dataset because they still contained useful information and reflected the real conditions encountered during harvesting. Only berries whose maturity could be visually determined were included in the reference annotations. Berries in severely overexposed regions, where their maturity could not be reliably identified, were excluded. The machine normally produces a filled crate approximately every 14 seconds per side, while the blue and white sides operate independently. In a situation where both sides require processing within the same period, two images would need to be analysed within approximately 14 seconds.
blocks.zh: 现场评价使用了79幅填充式的图像:40幅来自蓝方,39幅来自白方. 摄像头在1920×1080 1920\times 1080像素拍摄到图像. 这些图像没有在模型训练中使用. 数据集中保留了受太阳影响的图像,因为这些图像仍然载有有用的信息,反映了收获过程中遇到的实际条件。 参考说明中只有可视化确定成熟的浆果。 排除了严重过度暴露地区的贝里,因为无法可靠地查明其成熟程度。 机器通常每侧大约每14秒生产一个装满的箱子,而蓝白两侧则独立运行. 在双方需要在同一期间处理的情况下,需要在大约14秒内分析两个图像。

blocks.en: Commercial Class I packout results for two corresponding lots were considered as a downstream comparison after approximately six weeks of controlled-atmosphere cold storage. Individual imaged crates were not tracked through storage and sorting.
blocks.zh: 商业类 我对两个相应的批量的打包结果 被认为是一个下游的比较 大约六个星期的控制大气层冷藏。 没有通过储存和分类跟踪单个成像的箱子。

blocks.en: 3.10 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.10 评价计量

blocks.en: Object-detection performance was evaluated using mean average precision (mAP), precision, and recall. The mAP@50 metric measures average precision at an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.50, while mAP@50–95 averages the results over thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95. Precision is the proportion of predicted detections that are correct, and recall is the proportion of reference objects detected. The F1 score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, and macro-F1 is the average of the three class-wise F1 scores.
blocks.zh: 利用平均精度、精度和召回来来评价了物体探测性能。 mAP@50 度量衡在0.50的交叉-交叉(IoU)阈值上的平均精度,而mAP@50-95的平均精度值为0.50至0.95。 精度是预测检测正确的比例,召回是检测到的参考对象的比例. F1分是精度和召回的谐音平均值,宏观-F1是三个等级的F1分的平均值.

blocks.en: The ripe-fruit fraction was compared with the reference annotations using mean absolute error (MAE), root mean squared error (RMSE), mean bias, and Pearson’s correlation coefficient ( r r ). MAE is the average absolute difference between the predicted and reference fractions, RMSE gives greater weight to larger errors, and mean bias is the average signed difference. Pearson’s r r measures the linear relationship between the two fractions. Ripe-fraction errors are given in percentage points. Absolute counts were compared using count error and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), which expresses the average absolute counting difference relative to the reference count. For runtime results, P95 denotes the 95th percentile of the recorded times. Differences in per-image absolute ripe-fraction error between the two harvester sides were tested using Welch’s two-sample test, which does not assume equal variances.
blocks.zh: 成熟果分与参考说明相比,使用了平均绝对错误(MAE)、根平均方差(RMSE)、平均偏差和皮尔逊的相关系数(r r r )。 MAE是预测分数和参考分数之间的平均绝对差,RMSE给予较大差数更大的权重,平均值偏差是平均签名差数. Pearson的r度量两个分数之间的线性关系. Ripe-fraction 错误以百分点表示. 使用计数错误和平均绝对百分比错误(MAPE)来比较绝对计数,后者表示相对于参考计数的平均绝对计数差. 对于运行时间结果,P95表示记录时间的95%。 使用Welch的两样测试法测试了两个收割机双方在每幅图像绝对成熟折射误差方面的差异,该测试法假定差异不相等.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Model-Development Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 示范发展成果

blocks.en: The first single-class blueberry detector achieved a validation mAP@50 of 0.951 and mAP@50–95 of 0.688 on the 16 validation images. These images were separate from the training images, but they were used to select the best checkpoint. These values therefore describe model-development validation rather than independent final testing.
blocks.zh: 第一个单级蓝莓探测器在16个验证图像上实现了0.951的mAP@50和0.688的mAP@50-95验证. 这些图像与训练图像是分开的,但被用来选择最好的检查站. 因此,这些数值描述了模型开发验证而不是独立的最终测试.

blocks.en: The final three-class training run reached an mAP@50 of 0.772, mAP@50–95 of 0.704, precision of 0.932, and recall of 0.721. However, the dataset configuration used the same image directory for training and validation. These values are therefore treated as training diagnostics rather than independent estimates of performance on new images. The final three-class detector was evaluated separately on the field-acquired crate images in the following sections. The single-class and three-class mAP values are not directly comparable because the tasks and datasets were different.
blocks.zh: 最后的三期训练跑达到mAP@500.772,mAP@50–950.704,精度0.932,召回0.721. 然而,数据集配置使用相同的图像目录进行培训和验证. 因此,这些价值被视为培训诊断,而不是对新图像的业绩进行独立估计。 在以下各节中,现场获得的箱子图像分别评估了最后的三级探测器。 由于任务和数据集不同,单类和三类的mAP值不能直接比较.

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of input resolution on maturity estimation, three resolutions were compared: 640 × 640 640\times 640 , 960 × 960 960\times 960 , and 1280 × 1280 1280\times 1280 pixels. The absolute error in the estimated ripe-fruit fraction was 8.01 percentage points at 640 × 640 640\times 640 , decreasing to 2.60 percentage points at 960 × 960 960\times 960 and 2.24 percentage points at 1280 × 1280 1280\times 1280 . The higher resolution therefore produced the lowest error in this comparison. Based on these results, the 1280 × 1280 1280\times 1280 resolution was retained for deployment, as it provided the most accurate maturity estimate among the tested configurations.
blocks.zh: 为了评价输入分辨率对成熟度估计的影响,比较了三种分辨率:640×640 640\时间640,960×960\时间960,1280×1280\时间1280像素. 估计成熟果分的绝对误差为8.01个百分点,为640×640 640\时,为2.60个百分点,为960×960 960\时和2.24个百分点,为1280×1280 1280\时. 1280 (英语). 因此,较高的分辨率产生了这一比较中最低的错误。 基于这些结果,1280×1280 1280\时间的1280分辨率得以保留用于部署,因为它提供了测试配置中最准确的成熟度估计.

blocks.en: 4.2 Agreement With Manual Maturity Assessment
blocks.zh: 4.2 与人工成熟度评估达成协议

blocks.en: An example of the saved detection output from the white-side camera is shown in Fig. 3 . In this image, the detector identified 525 ripe, 28 semi-ripe, and 66 unripe berries, giving 619 detections in total and a ripe-fruit fraction of 84.8%. This illustrates the output for an individual crate rather than the overall maturity estimate.
blocks.zh: 白边相机中保存的检测输出的例子如图3所示. 在这张图像中,探测器确定了525个熟食,28个半熟食,66个未熟食浆果,总共发现619个熟食果实,分数84.8%. 这说明了单个箱子的产量,而不是总的成熟度估计。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Example of the system’s saved detection output for a white-side crate. Green, yellow, and red bounding boxes indicate ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe blueberries, respectively. The displayed “PACKOUT” value of 84.8% is the detected ripe-fruit fraction (525 of 619 detections), not commercial Class I packout.
blocks.zh: 图3:系统节省的白边箱检测输出实例。 绿色,黄色,红色的边框分别表示熟,半熟,和未熟蓝莓. 显示的84.8%的“PACKOUT”值是检测到的成熟果分(619次检测中有525次),而不是商业类I类包装。

blocks.en: Across the complete 79-image dataset, the manually determined ripe-fruit fraction was 90.97%, compared with 90.22% estimated by the vision system, corresponding to an aggregate difference of − 0.75 -0.75 percentage points. At the individual-image level, the MAE of the ripe-fruit fraction was 0.935 percentage points, with a RMSE of 1.165 percentage points. The mean signed error was − 0.719 -0.719 percentage points, indicating a small systematic tendency to underestimate the ripe-fruit fraction. The overall detection and maturity-estimation results, including the comparison between harvester sides, are summarized in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 在完整的79个图像数据集中,人工测定的成熟果分数为90.97%,而视觉系统估计的成熟果分数为90.22%,相当于0.75-0.75个百分点的总差额。 在个人形象层面,成熟果分的MAE为0.935个百分点,RMSE为1.165个百分点. 平均签名误差为−0.719-0.719个百分点,表明一种小的系统性倾向,低估了成熟水果分数。 表2汇总了总的探测和成熟度估计结果,包括收获方之间的比较。

blocks.en: Agreement remained high across the full observed maturity range. The Pearson correlation between predicted and reference ripe-fruit fractions was r = 0.967 r=0.967 , corresponding to a squared correlation coefficient of R 2 = 0.935 R^{2}=0.935 . The maximum absolute error observed for any individual image was 2.84 percentage points. Forty-five of the 79 images (57.0%) were within ± 1 \pm 1 percentage point of the manually determined value, 64 images (81.0%) were within ± 1.5 \pm 1.5 percentage points, and 73 images (92.4%) were within ± 2 \pm 2 percentage points. The agreement between predicted and manually determined ripe-fruit fractions is illustrated in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh: 在观察到的整个成熟度范围内,协议仍然很高。 预测的和参考的熟果分数之间的皮尔逊亲和系数为r = 0.967 r = 0.967,对应的平方亲和系数为R 2 = 0.935 R^{2}=0.935. 观察到的单个图像的最大绝对误差为2.84个百分点. 在79幅图像(57.0%)中,45幅在±1\pm1个百分点以内,64幅图像(81.0%)在±1.5\pm1.5个百分点以内,73幅图像(92.4%)在±2\pm2个百分点以内. 图1说明了预测的和人工确定的成熟果分之间的一致。 4 (英语).

blocks.en: Table 2: Overall perception performance and comparison between the white and blue harvester sides. Errors in ripe-fruit fraction are reported in percentage points (pp).
blocks.zh: 表2:白色和蓝色收割机两侧的总体感知性能和比较. 熟果分数的误差以百分点(pp)报告.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Predicted versus manually determined ripe-fruit fraction for 79 field-acquired crate images. The dashed line represents perfect 1:1 agreement.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 79个实地获得的箱型图像的熟果分数与人工确定的熟果分数对比。 虚线代表完美的1:1协议.

blocks.en: 4.3 Absolute Berry Counts
blocks.zh: 4.3 绝对莓数

blocks.en: The detector produced a larger number of detections than the manually verified reference annotations across the 79-image dataset. In total, 51,552 berries were detected compared with 48,634 berries in the reference annotations, corresponding to an overall overestimation of 6.00%. The predicted ripe-berry count was 46,510 compared with 44,243 reference annotations, an overestimation of 5.12%. The relative differences were larger for the less frequent maturity classes: 3,624 unripe berries were detected compared with 3,101 reference annotations (+16.87%), while 1,418 semi-ripe berries were detected compared with 1,290 reference annotations (+9.92%).
blocks.zh: 探测器在79图像数据集的检测数量比人工核实的参考说明多. 与参考说明中的48,634枚浆果相比,共检测到了51,552枚浆果,相当于总体高估6.00 %. 预测的成熟莓数为46,510,而参考说明为44,243,高估了5.12%。 在较不常见的成熟类中,相对差异较大:检测到3,624枚未熟浆果,而参考说明为3,101枚(+16.87%),检测到1,418枚半熟浆果,而参考说明为1,290枚(+9.92%)。

blocks.en: The greater relative overestimation of unripe and semi-ripe berries compared with ripe berries is consistent with the negative bias observed in the ripe-fruit fraction. However, the close agreement in maturity composition despite differences in absolute counts indicates that errors in individual berry detection had a substantially smaller effect on the estimated maturity composition than on absolute berry abundance.
blocks.zh: 与成熟的浆果相比,对未熟果和半熟果浆的相对高估与熟果部分观察到的负面偏差一致. 然而,尽管绝对数不同,但成熟度构成方面的密切一致表明,单个莓汁检测错误对成熟度估计构成的影响远远小于对绝对莓汁丰度的影响。

blocks.en: 4.4 Heuristic Estimate of Berries per Crate
blocks.zh: 4.4 每克拉底贝里斯热力学估计数

blocks.en: The approximate number of blueberries in each 6.5 kg crate was estimated using two complementary approaches: one based on berry size, density, and crate mass, and another based on the estimated volume of the berry pile.
blocks.zh: 每箱6.5公斤蓝莓的大致数量是采用两种补充方法估算的:一种是根据莓的大小、密度和箱体质量,另一种是根据莓堆的估计体积。

blocks.en: For the first approach, the median berry diameter was estimated from the widths of the YOLO bounding boxes, converted from pixels to centimetres using the known crate dimensions. The resulting median diameter was approximately 1.67 cm. Assuming that blueberries are approximately spherical, the volume of an individual berry was calculated as:

Assuming a bulk porosity of 0.40, based on [ 24 ] , approximately 60% of this volume was occupied by berries, corresponding to 6.54 L. blocks.en: The two approaches produced similar estimates of approximately 2600 and 2680 berries per crate. Based on these results, a representative value of approximately 2650 berries per 6.5 kg crate was adopted for interpreting the image-based results. This value should be considered a heuristic estimate rather than a direct count, as berry size, shape, packing density, and pile geometry may vary between crates.
blocks.zh: 这两种方法得出了大约每箱2600和2680个浆果的类似估计。 根据这些结果,采用了大约每6.5公斤箱2650个浆果的代表性值来解释以图像为基础的结果。 应将这一数值视为一个弹性估计,而不是直接计数,因为莓的大小、形状、包装密度和堆积几何可能因箱型而异。

blocks.en: 4.5 Effect of Sunlight
blocks.zh: 4.5 阳光的影响

blocks.en: The blue-side camera was affected by direct sunlight, resulting in partial overexposure of the crate images, while the white side provided more uniform lighting. Absolute counting error was also larger on the blue side, with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 7.80%, compared with 5.64% on the white side. These results indicate a reduction in individual object detection performance under the blue-side imaging conditions, although recall remained above 97% for both camera streams.
blocks.zh: 蓝边照相机受到直接阳光的影响,导致板条箱画面部分暴露过度,而白色侧则提供了更统一的照明. 蓝色方面绝对计数错误也较大,平均绝对百分比错误(MAPE)为7.80%,而白色方面为5.64%. 这些结果显示,在蓝边成像条件下,单个物体的探测性能有所下降,尽管两个相机流的回溯率仍然高于97%.

blocks.en: The lower individual-object detection performance on the blue side did not correspond to a higher error in the maturity-composition estimate. The blue-side images produced a ripe-fraction MAE of 0.87 percentage points, compared with 1.00 percentage points on the white side. The difference in per-image absolute ripe-fraction error between the two sides was not statistically significant ( p = 0.39 p=0.39 , Welch’s two-sample test). The reference ripe-fruit fractions were also nearly identical between the two sides (Table 2 ). These results suggest that the relative maturity-composition estimate was less sensitive to the side-specific imaging conditions than absolute berry counting.
blocks.zh: 蓝色一侧的个别物体探测性能较低,这与成熟度-组合估计值的较高错误并不对应. 蓝边图像产生成熟折射的MAE为0.87个百分点,而白边为1.00个百分点. 双方的偶象绝对成熟折射误差在统计学上并不显著(p=0.39 p=0.39,Welch的两样测试). 参考成熟水果分数在双方之间也几乎相同(表2)。 这些结果表明,相对成熟-组合估计对侧面特异性成像条件的敏感度低于绝对的莓计数.

blocks.en: 4.6 Single-image runtime benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.6 单一图像运行时间基准

blocks.en: For a representative blueberry image, preprocessing took approximately 70.6 ms, model inference took approximately 3882.1 ms, and counting the detected berries took approximately 1.2 ms. The complete processing time was therefore approximately 3953.9 ms, or about 4 seconds per image.
blocks.zh: 对于具有代表性的蓝莓图像,预处理需要约70.6 ms,模型推论需要约3882.1 ms,计算检测到的浆果需要约1.2 ms. 因此,完整的处理时间约为3953.9毫秒,即每幅图像约4秒.

blocks.en: A separate OpenVINO benchmark was also used to compare two model input sizes. The 1280 model required approximately 4000 ms per image, while the 960 model required approximately 2645 ms per image. The lower-resolution model was therefore considerably faster.
blocks.zh: 单独的OpenVINO基准也被用来比较两个模型输入大小. 1280型机车每幅图像需要约4000 ms,而960型机车每幅图像需要约2645 ms. 因此,低分辨率模型的速度要快得多。

blocks.en: 4.7 Field Runtime and Event-Handling Performance
blocks.zh: 4.7 外地运行时间和活动处理业绩

blocks.en: Mean model inference time on the CPU-only industrial computer was 4.32 s per image, while mean recorded processing time, including image acquisition and post-processing, was 4.93 s. The time from the machine trigger to the result had a median of 5.84 s and a maximum of 11.13 s. All 79 events produced a corresponding result within the required 14 s per-side crate interval (Table 3 ). No images were removed due to an empty crate, a failed capture, an incorrect trigger, or an unusable camera view.
blocks.zh: 仅CPU工业计算机上的平均模型推断时间为每幅图像的4.32s,而包括图像获取和后处理在内的平均记录处理时间为4.93s. 从机器触发到结果的时间中位数为5.84秒,最高为11.13秒. 所有79项事件在规定的每箱间距14秒内产生了相应的结果(表3)。 由于一个空箱子、一个失败的捕获、一个错误的触发器或一个无法使用的相机视图,没有删除图像 。

blocks.en: Overlapping trigger events occurred repeatedly because the two crate streams operated independently. Of the 78 intervals, 28 (35.9%) were shorter than 14 s and 14 (17.9%) were shorter than 5 s. The closest observed pair of blue and white side triggers occurred only 0.101 s apart; the corresponding results became available after 6.44 s and 11.13 s, respectively. This field-observed case demonstrates that the single-CPU event-processing pipeline could accommodate near-simultaneous requests from both crate streams without exceeding the 14-second interval.
blocks.zh: 由于两箱流独立运行,多次发生重叠触发事件。 在这78个间隔中,28个间隔(35.9%)短于14秒,14个间隔(17.9%)短于5秒。 观察到的最接近的一对蓝色和白色的侧式触发器只相隔0.101秒;相应的结果分别在6.44秒和11.13秒后公布. 现场观察的这一案例表明,单一CPU事件处理管道可以满足两个箱流的近乎同步的请求,而不超出14秒间隔。

blocks.en: Table 3: Runtime performance measured from the 79 trigger events. Trigger-to-result latency includes the intentional 1 s settling delay and any waiting caused by overlapping events.
blocks.zh: 表3:从79起触发事件测得的运行时间性能. 触发到结果的延迟包括故意的1号结算延迟和由重叠事件造成的任何等待。

blocks.en: 4.8 Downstream commercial packout
blocks.zh: 4.8 下游商业包装

blocks.en: Two corresponding lots contained a total of approximately 5144 kg of fruit and produced Class I packout rates of 83.3% and 85.6%. Weighted by lot mass, the combined Class I packout was approximately 83.8%.
blocks.zh: 两个相应的批量共含有约5144公斤水果,并生产了83.3%和85.6%的I类包装率. 以批量重量计算,I类综合包装约为83.8%.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: 5.1 Measuring harvest quality during harvesting
blocks.zh: 5.1 测量收获质量

blocks.en: The system developed in this study analyses berries after they have been removed from the bush, but while the harvester is still operating. Each filled crate therefore provides information about the result of the harvesting process. The present study extends real-time harvested-product quality monitoring to blueberry harvesting, with berry maturity as the measured variable.
blocks.zh: 本研究中开发的系统分析浆果从灌木丛中除去后,但收割机仍在运行. 因此,每个装满的箱子都提供了关于收获过程结果的信息。 本研究将实时收获产品质量监测扩大到蓝莓收获,以莓成熟度为测量变量.

blocks.en: 5.2 Real-time operation
blocks.zh: 5.2 实时作业

blocks.en: The field logs indicate that event-triggered inference can meet the observed workload on the existing CPU-only computer without a dedicated GPU. However, longer field trials would be needed to evaluate performance at higher crate rates.
blocks.zh: 场日志显示,事件触发推论可以在没有专用GPU的情况下满足现有CPU独家计算机的观测工作量. 然而,需要进行较长的实地试验,以便以更高的箱式费率评价业绩。

blocks.en: 5.3 Effect of sunlight
blocks.zh: 5.3 阳光的影响

blocks.en: The higher counting error under direct sunlight suggests that more stable lighting could improve detection. Other agricultural quality-monitoring systems have also shown that controlled lighting is important [ 4 , 12 , 13 ] . For the blueberry system, a practical improvement would be to add a shade or small imaging tunnel around the crate. LED lighting could then create more stable conditions.
blocks.zh: 直接阳光下较高的计数误差表明,更稳定的照明可以改善检测. 其他农业质量监测系统也表明,受控照明很重要[4、12、13]。 对于蓝莓系统来说,一个实际的改进就是在箱子周围增加一个遮荫或小成像隧道. 然后LED照明可以创造更稳定的条件.

blocks.en: 5.4 Top-layer limitation
blocks.zh: 5.4 顶层限制

blocks.en: Across the 79 field images, the manual annotations contained an average of approximately 616 visible berries per crate, compared with the heuristic estimate of approximately 2650 berries in a full 6.5 kg crate. The camera therefore observes about 23% of the berries in each crate. If these visible berries were a simple random sample of the full crate, a binomial approximation with a finite-population correction gives a nominal 95% sampling uncertainty of approximately ± 2 \pm 2 percentage points around the observed ripe fraction of approximately 91%. However, the visible berries form a surface sample rather than a random sample, so this calculation does not account for possible systematic differences between the top layer and berries deeper in the crate. Future work should therefore test whether the maturity composition of the visible top layer is representative of the full crate.
blocks.zh: 在79个实地图像中,人工说明中平均每箱含约616个醒目的浆果,而热力估计则约2650个浆果装在一个6.5公斤的整箱箱中。 因此,摄影机观察到每箱约23%的浆果。 如果这些可见的浆果是整个箱子的简单随机样本,二进制近似值加上有限的人口修正,则标称95%的采样不确定性约为±2\pm2个百分点,围绕观测到的成熟部分约91%。 然而,可见的浆果形成表面样本而不是随机样本,因此这种计算没有考虑到板条箱内顶层和浆果更深处可能存在的系统性差异. 因此,今后的工作应检验可见顶层的成熟度成分是否代表整个箱。

blocks.en: 5.5 Dataset and model limitations
blocks.zh: 5.5 数据集和模型限制

blocks.en: The training dataset was relatively small and included both public blueberry images and a limited number of crate images. Images of berries on bushes are different from images of densely packed berries in crates.
blocks.zh: 培训数据集相对较小,既包括公共蓝莓图像,也包括数量有限的箱型图像。 灌木丛上浆果的图像与箱内密集包装浆果的图像不同.

blocks.en: The model also performed better on ripe berries than on unripe and semi-ripe berries. This is important because missing unripe berries could make the calculated maturity-composition estimate appear higher than it really is.
blocks.zh: 该模型在成熟的浆果上的表现也优于未熟的浆果和半熟的浆果. 这一点很重要,因为缺失的未磨浆果可能会使计算出来的成熟-组分估计值显得比实际要高.

blocks.en: 5.6 Future harvest automation
blocks.zh: 5.6 未来收获自动化

blocks.en: The long-term goal is to use this information to improve machine settings. However, maturity alone is not enough to control the harvester. A high ripe percentage could mean the machine is working well, but it could also mean the machine is shaking too gently, leaving many ripe berries on the bush. A future control system would therefore need information about both harvest quality and fruit recovery.
blocks.zh: 长期的目标是利用这些信息改善机器设置. 然而,仅靠成熟不足以控制收割机. 成熟率高可能意味着机器运行良好,但也可能意味着机器摇得太轻,在灌木丛上留下许多成熟的浆果. 因此,未来的控制系统需要关于收获质量和水果回收的信息。

blocks.en: Existing research already provides some of these additional measurements, including canopy sensing, header control, debris detection, and yield mapping [ 6 , 11 , 22 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有的研究已经提供了其中一些额外的测量,包括树冠感应、头部控制、碎片探测和产量测绘[6、11、22、23]。

blocks.en: 5.7 Meaning of the maturity measurement and downstream packout
blocks.zh: 5.7 (中文(简体) ). 成熟度计量和下游包装的含义

blocks.en: The current system should not yet be described as measuring full commercial packout. Commercial packout can depend on many factors, including maturity, firmness, bruising, size, decay, and foreign material. Some of these properties cannot be measured reliably using a normal RGB image [ 9 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 目前的系统尚不应被描述为衡量全面商业包装。 商业包装可能取决于许多因素,包括成熟度,坚固度,瘀伤度,大小,衰变度,以及外国材料. 其中一些属性无法使用正常的RGB图像可靠地测量[9,15].

blocks.en: The full three-class result is therefore important. Reporting ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe berries separately gives more information than using only one final percentage. It can show whether changes in the harvesting process are mainly affecting clearly unripe fruit, semi-ripe fruit, or both.
blocks.zh: 因此,完整的三等结果很重要。 报告成熟、半角浆和未角浆分开提供的信息多于只使用最后百分比。 它可以显示收获过程的变化是主要影响明显未熟果,半熟果,还是两者兼而有之.

blocks.en: The commercial Class I packout was lower than the harvest-time ripe-fruit fraction, but this is not a direct disagreement because the measurements address different characteristics.
blocks.zh: 商业类I类包装比收获期成熟水果分数要低,但这不是直接的分歧,因为测量涉及不同的特性。

blocks.en: The difference is also consistent with previous work showing that not all fruit remains marketable after extended storage, even under controlled-atmosphere conditions. Forney et al. stored five highbush blueberry cultivars for six weeks at 1 ∘ C and reported an average of 88.5% marketable fruit under atmospheres containing 10–20 kPa CO 2 and 10 kPa O 2 [ 10 ] . Their definition of marketable fruit and the cultivars studied differ from the commercial Class I packout used here, so the values are not directly comparable. However, the result provides useful context for the Class I packout observed after a similar storage period.
blocks.zh: 这一差异也与先前的研究表明,并非所有水果在长期储存后仍可出售,即使在受控大气条件下也是如此。 福尔尼等人. 1°C时储存了5种高嘴蓝莓栽培植物,为期6周,并报告说在含有10-20千帕CO 2和10千帕O 2 [10] 的大气中,平均有88.5%的可销售水果。 它们对于可销售水果和所研究的栽培品种的定义与这里所用的商业类I类包装不同,因此其数值并不直接可比. 然而,这一结果为在类似储存期之后观察到的第一类包装提供了有益的背景。

blocks.en: The packout result is therefore a downstream commercial comparison rather than a direct validation of the maturity estimate. Because the commercial packout data represent a much larger harvested lot than the 79 crates used for the vision evaluation, crate-level packout errors or correlations cannot be calculated.
blocks.zh: 因此,包装结果是一种下游商业比较,而不是对到期估计的直接验证。 由于商业包装数据比用于视觉评价的79箱大得多,因此无法计算箱级包装错误或关联性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: This study developed and field-tested an event-triggered RGB vision system for estimating the maturity composition of mechanically harvested blueberries. The system combines crate imaging, three-class maturity detection, and CPU-only edge inference to measure fruit directly on the harvester while harvesting is still in progress.
blocks.zh: 该研究开发并实地测试了一个事件触发的RGB视觉系统,用于估计机械收获蓝莓的成熟度组成. 该系统结合了板条箱成像,三级成熟度检测,以及CPU唯一的边缘推论,在收获时直接测量收割机上的水果.

blocks.en: Field evaluation on 79 crate images showed close agreement between the vision-based and manually determined maturity composition. The manually determined ripe-fruit fraction was 90.97%, compared with 90.22% estimated by the system. At the individual-image level, the ripe-fruit estimate achieved a mean absolute error of 0.935 percentage points and a Pearson correlation of r = 0.967 r=0.967 . The deployed system was also sufficiently fast for the observed crate flow: mean recorded processing time was 4.93 s per image, while the harvester provided approximately 14 s between crates per side.
blocks.zh: 对79个箱型图像的实地评价表明,基于视觉的成熟度成分与人工确定的成熟度成分之间有着密切的一致。 人工测定的成熟水果分数为90.97%,而系统估计为90.22%。 在个人形象层面,成熟果估计实现平均绝对误差0.935个百分点,皮尔逊相关误差为r=0.967 r=0.967. 部署的系统对观察到的箱子流动速度也足够快:平均记录的处理时间为每张图像4.93秒,而收割机在每侧箱子之间提供了大约14秒。

blocks.en: These results indicate that maturity composition can be estimated reliably enough for real-time on-harvester monitoring, even though absolute berry counts were more sensitive to detection errors and changing illumination. The current system estimates visible fruit maturity rather than complete commercial packout. Future work should therefore focus on controlled illumination, multi-day and multi-cultivar validation, improved sampling of the harvested fruit stream, and integration with measurements of fruit recovery and losses.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,成熟度成分可以可靠地估计,以便实时进行收获机监测,即使绝对的浆果计数对检测错误和不断变化的照明更敏感。 目前的系统估计可见的水果成熟度,而不是完整的商业包装。 因此,今后的工作应侧重于有控制的照明、多天和多耕作的验证、改进收获水果流的取样,以及与水果回收和损失的测量相结合。
